### Following the Blueprint
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/following-the-blueprint
Passage: Joshua 14:1-5
Points:
- Israel distributed Canaan by carefully adhering to the detailed blueprint God previously gave through Moses.
- Apportioning land according to tribe size demonstrated God's fairness and concern for each family's needs.
- Assigning land by lot prevented larger tribes from seizing prime territory or oppressing smaller tribes.
- Even when the allocation process appeared complex, God sovereignly directed every outcome.
- Believers can trust God's providential ordering of their lives and celebrate their ultimate inheritance in Christ.

### Bible Pathway - Mar. 18, 2011
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-mar-18-2011.html
Passage: Joshua 14:1
Points:
- God spent centuries orchestrating history to prepare Israel for their specific tribal inheritances.
- Human judgment tends to seek what seems superficially advantageous, but only God knows what is best.
- Fulfilling the will of God requires stepping out in prompt obedience rather than waiting for convenience.
- God's sovereign blueprint works in harmony with the willing service of His people.
- Believers can rest assured that life events are guided by divine purpose rather than chance.
